body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Mechanics of abrasion”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Part type on the page is an S-tube large-end and small-end seal kit. Unit: set. The six-piece note is printed on the φ220 large-end row, not on this φ250 row. Material is a missing field. Service life is a missing field. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The S-tube seal page does not point to Electric 20, HBT8018, LZ-60 or any other model slug. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“力学的 磨耗”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 页面上的配件类型是 S 管大端与小端密封套件。单位：套。六件套说明印在 φ220 大端行，不在 φ250 这一行。 材料是缺字段。寿命是缺字段。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 S 管密封页没有指向电动20、HBT8018、LZ-60 或任何其他型号地址。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Abrasive minerals”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write S-tube large-end seal, φ250, and the quantity in sets. For φ220, say whether the six-piece kit is the row you checked on the machine. For other large-end sizes, do not add a six-piece count. The φ250 large-end seal is one kit row on the Xingtai S-tube seal page. Large-end rows are φ210, φ220 and φ250. Small-end rows are φ80, φ90, φ100 and φ105. This note is the φ250 large-end row only. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“来源章节：Abrasive minerals”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明 S 管大端密封、φ250 和套数。φ220 要写明机器上核对的是不是六件套那一行。其他大端尺寸不要自行加上六件套件数。 φ250 大端密封是邢台 S 管密封页上的一行套件。大端是 φ210、φ220、φ250。小端是 φ80、φ90、φ100、φ105。本文只写 φ250 大端这一行。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Manufactured abrasives”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The heading stops there.
